title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E01 — Clay County Detention Center
In Clay County, Mississippi, where gun deaths are an epidemic and the median income sits 66% below the national average, Sheriff Scott and his team fight to keep order inside a jail where the consequences of a community in crisis arrive daily.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E03 — Suffolk County Correctional Facility
As an opioid epidemic grips the county, a law-and-order sheriff uses rehabilitation to help inmates break the cycle of addiction while officers work around the clock to maintain safety, security and order inside one of New York's busiest jails.

title: Street Outlaws: Locals Only
description:
S02 E11 — The Axman Cometh
Pennsylvania locals go all-out for $5,000. With Caden Rankin, the son of an NPK racer, in the field, all bets are off. But our favorites don't always win, and whoever goes all the way will be racing against Axman, known for never backing down.

title: Gold Rush: White Water
description:
S08 E10 — Dustin's White Whale
A mysterious white boulder dubbed Moby could be the gateway to more monster nuggets, but Mother Nature throws Dustin a sucker punch -- she won't give up her gold without a fight.

title: Deadliest Catch: The Viking Returns
description:
S01 E05 — Hard Won Legacy
Sig searches for secrets from a fishing legend; when Jake locates relatives, he puts together pieces of his family's past and finds unexpected answers about his own late father; Clark must prove can tank the crab on his own.

title: Deadliest Catch: The Viking Returns
description:
S01 E06 — Norse Inheritance
After guaranteeing a troll crab delivery backed by king crab, Sig must make good on his deal before the clock runs out; Jake makes peace with his late father's passing; Mandy finds she has an eye for traditional Norwegian cuisine.

title: Deadliest Catch: The Viking Returns
description:
S01 E07 — All on the Line
Sig makes an ambitious deal for 25 tons of live king crab; Mandy hits the docks to buy a new boat; Sig and Jake scramble to the Russian line to find the migrating hoard; when Jake gets a line in his own prop, he must find a diver to save his shaft.

title: Deadliest Catch: The Viking Returns
description:
S01 E08 — For King and Country
Thousands of pounds short of their million-dollar Norwegian goal, Sig and Jake steam far to the north to fill their tanks with Russian kings; when Clark finds uncertain depths at shore, Mandy captains a new boat.

title: In the Eye of the Storm: Chasers
description:
S01 E01 — Twister Shapeshifter
Near Gary, S.D., expert chasers and certified weather spotters self-shoot an encounter with a long-track, shape-shifting tornado; when the twister takes a turn towards an occupied farmhouse, chasers are thrust into the role of first responders.

title: In the Eye of the Storm: Chasers
description:
S01 E06 — Tornado of the Year
Every year tornado junkies descend on America's tornado alley; these storm chasers put everything on the line to prove they're the best in the game.

title: In the Eye of the Storm: Chasers
description:
S01 E03 — Danger Close in Dakota
Teams of expert storm chasers and certified weather spotters risk it all to venture into America's Tornado Alley; they self-shoot their encounters with nature at its most extreme, warn people in harm's way and help save lives when disaster strikes.

title: In the Eye of the Storm: Chasers
description:
S01 E05 — Spin City
While chasing a monster in Alabama, Sarah parts ways with Reed moments before he takes the Dominator for a spin inside a tornado.

title: Filthy Fortunes
description:
S01 E05 — All the Smoke or Going Broke
Matt must turn BBQ smokers into big bucks at a Texas-sized mess in Houston, Texas; at a second job, a massive termite infestation could eat the profits.

title: Filthy Fortunes
description:
S01 E01 — Betting Big on Little Balls
In a modern-day treasure hunt, Matt Paxton, the "King of Hoards," gambles that he can clean out dangerously cluttered homes and find hidden riches; Matt and his team search for a vintage Mustang, military artifacts, and a $60,000 marble collection.

title: Filthy Fortunes
description:
S01 E02 — Hunting for Silver Bullets
Matt tackles a dangerous, ten-acre hoard in the Pennsylvania woods to hunt high-value guns and ammo; the old-school machinist's property is packed with heavy equipment and scrap metal, but $25,000 worth of precious metal could make a bet pay off.

title: Filthy Fortunes
description:
S02 E10 — Gunning for Ghost Town Green
Matt is shocked when clients reveal a Pioneer Village that's become a ghost town after three decades of abandonment; Matt hunts for a rare Colt prototype and a Babe Ruth autograph rumored to be on a hot dog wrapper.

title: Homestead Rescue: Intervention
description:
S01 E06 — North Carolina DIY or Die
After the tragic loss of his father and wife, a young homesteader attempts to survive alone in the mountains of NC using off-grid skills he learned online; when the Raneys intervene, they find a crumbling shelter and no means of subsistence.

title: Homestead Rescue: Intervention
description:
S01 E02 — A Homestead Divided
On a mesa in Arizona, the Raneys step into a homestead and marriage under strain; to secure the family's future, they must pull an ambitious husband away from his years-long, unfinished passion project, and force a hard reset before total collapse.

title: Homestead Rescue: Intervention
description:
S01 E03 — Wylde Mountain Reckoning
In Montana, the Raneys intervene with a family on winter's doorstep; they must scramble to expand their shelter and food storage before being snowed in for good; a surprising revelation in the middle of the rescue threatens to upend the Raneys' plan.

title: Homestead Rescue: Intervention
description:

title: Moonshiners: Master Distiller
description:
S02 E09 — Pot-Still Vodka
Distillers compete to make vodka; the secret to surviving a Russian winter and now America's most-consumed spirit.

title: Gold Rush: White Water
description:
S08 E11 — Get Rich or Die Trying
Feeling the squeeze of winter's grip tightening around them, desperation pushes the miners a step too far in their search for millions in gold.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S07 E01 — Terror of Nazi Propaganda
After seizing power in 1933, Adolf Hitler began systematically transforming a peaceful German population into a ruthless war machine; experts investigate the innovative methods used by the Nazis to indoctrinate and control the will of its citizens.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S07 E04 — Secrets of Gobekli Tepe
The ancient site of Göbekli Tepe is the oldest building complex ever discovered and continues to baffle archaeologists; experts investigate new theories behind its construction as a possible commemoration to a cataclysmic event.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S07 E05 — Mystery of the Hypogeum
A subterranean Neolithic temple discovered on the island of Malta contains the skeletal remains of thousands of humans; experts use forensic archaeology to investigate elongated skulls that may unlock the secrets of an advanced, lost civilization.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S07 E07 — MK-Ultra Revealed
The CIA's MK-Ultra program sought to create mind control methods through unethical human experimentation, and now, experts investigate classified documents that reveal the horrific atrocities that were carried out in the pursuit of national security.

title: Expedition X
description:
S09 E02 — Beast of Boggy Creek
The team heads to Arkansas, where a swamp monster has terrorized the small, rural town of Fouke for over a century.

title: Expedition X
description:
S08 E02 — Trapped in the Asylum
Josh, Heather and Phil continue their investigation into a haunted lunatic asylum; they encounter extreme paranormal activity, capturing stunning evidence that convinces them this is their most terrifying expedition yet.

title: Expedition X
description:
S08 E07 — Castle of Terror
The team goes to England to explore Chillingham, Britain's most haunted castle; thousands died in brutal battles on its grounds or by horrifying tortures in its dungeons; now, hostile spirits are said to roam the medieval building, seeking vengeance.

title: Expedition X
description:
S10 E08 — Rock of Nightmares
Exploring miles of abandoned tunnels inside the Rock of Gibraltar in pursuit of a ghostly local legend: the Mad Monk; digging deeper into its bloody history leads to a notoriously violent prison, where the walls are built from bones.

title: Expedition X
description:
S10 E07 — Texas Chupacabra
Heather and Phil sniff out the trail of a vampiric Chupacabra said to be terrorizing eastern Texas; joined by a new high-tech hound, can their robot companion help them catch this Badlands bloodsucker in the act?

title: Expedition X
description:
S11 E01 — Secrets of Vulture City
Heather and Jack Osbourne investigate Vulture City, Ariz., a ghost town with Gold Rush-era spirits; they explore possible ancient, darker forces.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E02 — The Kilted Keisterer?
Tizzy identifies a brazen shopper who places merchandise under his kilt; an angry golfer tees off on bystanders; a man has an ice cream truck meltdown; a woman claims a public beach as her own private yard.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E01 — The Tesla Terrorizer
A woman is caught on camera defecating on a car; a man makes off with a tow truck, wreaking havoc through the streets of New York City.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E03 — The Tip Jar Bandit
Tizzy investigates complaints of a serial tip jar thief; a woman goes on a tirade in a parking lot; the police sort out a cyclist's accusations against a motorist.

title: Expedition X
description:
S12 E01 — Robin Hood's Ghosts
The team travels to Nottingham, home to the legend of Robin Hood; as they investigate whether centuries of bloodshed have left a paranormal legacy of terror, their search leads them to Sherwood Forest, and a seeming encounter with the restless dead.

title: Expedition X
description:
S12 E02 — Secrets of Sherwood Forest
Phil and Heather continue their investigation into the dark legend of Robin Hood in Nottingham, England; while exploring reports of hostile ghosts in a medieval prison and sinister pagan rituals in Sherwood Forest, the team uncovers shocking answers.

title: Expedition X
description:
Curse of the Skinwalkers
A series of terrifying encounters in the Navajo Nation has renewed fears of the legendary Skinwalker. With the help of a local expert, Phil and Heather journey deep into a cursed valley and investigate a cave that few dare to enter.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E05 — The Nightmare Neighbor
Tizzy sparks an internet movement to end a woman's racially charged harassment of her neighbors; a parking lot guard is targeted by a driver; a disgruntled customer wrecks a GameStop.

description:
S01 E02 — Bluefin Bloodline
Captains Joe and Tyler hit bluefin gold as second-generation harpooner, Niko Chaprales, fails to land even one.

title: Gold Rush: White Water
description:
S08 E12 — Dancing With Death
Mother Nature serves Dustin an eviction notice. With a season-ending blizzard in the forecast, the miners must push past their limits to add to their record gold haul by dredging every last ounce from the freezing depths of Nugget Creek.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S02 E10 — I'm Clean, Bro
An illicit shipment is disguised in bags of concrete; officers identify a criminal wanted for burglary when he attempts to cross the border; a woman is caught smuggling too many diet pills; a retired police officer almost carries a gun into Mexico.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S02 E01 — Cross-Border Smuggling
A man returning from Mexico requires emergency Narcan after a suspected opioid overdose; an unlikely family is caught trying to smuggle firearms into Mexico; a woman attempting to sneak prescription meds into the U.S. is caught red-handed.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S05 E09 — Running on Empty
Officers find farm equipment packed full of narcotics; teenagers are caught smuggling anti-anxiety pills; a truck is found with a secret compartment full of drugs, requiring a complex code to open it; a van's gas tank has more than fuel in it.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S05 E01 — Put Your Shirt Back On
An expectant mother gets caught with an unexpected load in her car; officers stumble upon a shipment of narcotics not-so-secretly concealed; a bounty hunter has trouble keeping her cool when officers find she's carrying something illegal.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S05 E04 — Pulp Addiction
Officers in Hidalgo are forced to close the bridge when it's stormed by asylum seekers attempting to jump ahead of hundreds of people waiting to seek refuge in the US; a cavity search reveals a pill smuggler concealing meds in an unpleasant place.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned: Hidden America
description:
S03 E05 — Secrets of the Catskill Game Farm
A rundown nature park is full of strange secrets and connections; futuristic machines are the forgotten result of a plan to modernize American transit; a subterranean town serves as a refuge in the Wild West.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned: Hidden America
description:
S03 E02 — The Secrets and Troubles of Cahawba
A Revolutionary leader visits Alabama's first capital and leaves it bankrupt; an Oregon fort refuses to engage an enemy submarine during World War II; a film studio in Jacksonville, Fla. caters to a new audience.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned: Hidden America
description:
S03 E06 — Ghosts of Montana State Prison
A Montana small town branded by an infamous jailbreak; how nature trumped greed during an Alaska treasure hunt; a cultural icon from the rough side of New Orleans; the Empire State of the South.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned: Hidden America
description:
S03 E04 — Banished From Bisbee
A labor strike in an Arizona mining town ends in a mass kidnapping and deportation; a unique homesteading community gets its start in the Old West; a leaning Carolina lighthouse becomes part of Civil War history.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned: Hidden America
description:
S03 E03 — The Forgotten Soldiers of Camp Naco
Forgotten soldiers of the Old West guard a fort at the southern border.

title: Dirty Jobs
description:
S06 E28 — Barber's Assistant
Mike learns some of the tricks of the haircutting trade; Mike spends the day working as a landfill operator.

title: Dirty Jobs
description:
S06 E26 — Doomsday Seed Banker
The millennium seed project collects and preserves flora seeds for replanting after a catastrophic event.

title: Dirty Jobs
description:
S06 E25 — Fossil Hunter
Mike takes on his latest challenge, traveling to Utah to take on the surprisingly dirty job of being a paleontologist.

title: Dirty Jobs
description:
S06 E29 — Mardi Gras Bladder Banger
Mike spends the day in Mobile, Ala., assembling cow bladders that will be used during a Mardi Gras parade.

title: Dirty Jobs
description:
S10 E11 — Manhole Rehab; Clock Caretaker
Mike Rowe descends into the depths of an aging manhole, coating it with a polyurea liner to extend its warranty in Murfreesboro, Tenn.; Mike joins a horologist and a priest to set the time right as he restores a historic clock tower.

title: Dirty Jobs
description:
S09 E03 — Tugboat Fitter; Tower Cleaner
Mike visits a ship-building community in Coden, Ala., to learn the ins and outs of building a tugboat; he makes a long climb to the top of a dirty water tower in Magee, Miss., to clean inside the tank.

title: Dirty Jobs
description:
S10 E14 — Beaver Relocator; Slime Master
Mike Rowe goes to the mountains in Utah and gives a dam to a couple nuisance beavers causing havoc for municipalities; Mike gets a little sticky while working with a special effects artist at a glue factory in LA.

title: Dirty Jobs
description:
S09 E04 — Rock Sucker; Mountain Carver
Mike sucks rocks off an industrial roof with a massive vacuum; then, he travels to the Black Hills to carve one of the largest monuments in the world: Crazy Horse.

title: This Is Mark Rober
description:
S01 E03 — Attack of the Squirrels
In his quest to understand terminal velocity, Mark carefully studies some furry friends before jumping out of an airplane to become a flying human squirrel.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S13 E01 — Moonshine is a Miracle
Tickle launches a campaign to legalize home distilling, while Mark and Digger devise a plan to distill pallets of unsold light beer into liquor; hobbled by racing injuries, Josh plots his return to making shine; Digger makes a shocking revelation.

title: Homestead Rescue
description:
S03 E07 — Storm Shelter Showdown
A hungry bear scratching the walls, disease-carrying ticks, no food to eat, no power and 60 massive oaks looming over a flimsy cabin in tornado alley present the Raneys with their greatest challenges yet.

title: Homestead Rescue
description:
Storm Shelter Showdown, Part 2
A hungry bear scratching the walls, disease-carrying ticks, no food to eat, no power and 60 massive oaks looming over a flimsy cabin in tornado alley present the Raneys with their greatest challenges yet.

title: Homestead Rescue
description:
S02 E03 — Trapped
The Raneys assist two Montana homesteaders who face being trapped on their property; when a medical emergency strikes, the Raneys face their first ever failed rescue.

title: Homestead Rescue
description:
S03 E06 — Drowning
In Hawaii, the Raneys attempt to save two homesteaders whose dream homestead is in a flash-flood zone; as the weather closes in, they try to save the property from the water.

title: MythBusters
description:
S17 E04 — Video Games Special
Adam and Jamie challenge the science of virtual worlds from video games.

title: MythBusters
description:
S17 E06 — San Francisco Drift
Adam and Jamie put the pedal to the metal and set out to test two tall tales from the street racing world; they investigate whether oversteering increases agility and if reverse parking is still possible using the drifting technique.

title: MythBusters
description:
S18 E01 — Blow It Out of the Water
Adam and Jamie blow up a boat with 1,000 lbs. of high explosive; homemade machine gun from the "Breaking Bad" finale.

title: MythBusters
description:
S17 E03 — The A-Team Special
Adam and Jamie examine "The A-Team"; they find out whether it's possible to build a working cannon using materials abandoned in a barn.

title: MythBusters
description:
S18 E06 — Unfinished Business
Adam and Jamie tackle fan favorites; video games; grenades; spy cars; superfast firearms.
